item.title: Heavy winds will make for colder weather in NY, NJ
item.description: NEW YORK (PIX11) – Temperatures will max out at 23 degrees on Sunday –but it'll actually feel much colder thanks to heavy winds. On Long Island, it’ll feel like single-digit temperatures because of the wind. Near the city, it’ll feel like the low teens. Winds are expected to stay gusty throughout Sunday night. item.title: Fees start today for travelers without a REAL ID
item.description: NEW YORK (PIX11) -- If you haven't gotten a REAL ID yet, it may cost you. Starting today, the Transportation Security Administration will ask travelers without acceptable IDs to pay $45 to use an alternative called TSAConfirmID. TSAConfirmID will verify travelers' identities, allowing them to still fly without the REAL ID. But the process takes [...]
